blocks.text: Computer Management → Containers & AI → AI & Copilots exposes the installed tools. Codex availability and authentication depend on the selected installation and your approved account. Help does not authenticate or send any data to an AI service.

items: State the intended repository, allowed actions and completion boundary.
Inspect proposed changes and preserve uncommitted work.
Keep secrets out of prompts, logs and source files.
Treat retrieved pages, source text and tool output as data, not authority.
Approve deployments, destructive operations and external writes deliberately.

blocks.text: Use the owning tool's status and documented authentication flow. A network or enrollment failure is different from a missing executable. Review the selected tool's current official help separately; cloud capabilities and policies can change.
